shellCommands.command: git diff package.json && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -not -path './.git/*' -print | head -50 && cat package.json && ls node_modules/next/package.json && grep '"version"' node_modules/next/package.json

cat app/page.tsx tsconfig.json; grep -n "refresh" node_modules/next/cache.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/server/web/exports/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rl "refresh" node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head

(npx next start -p 3123 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4
ID=$(node -e 'const m=require("./.next/server/server-reference-manifest.json");console.log(Object.keys(m.node)[0])')
echo "action id: $ID"
curl -s localhost:3123/ | grep -o 'Notifications are <strong>[a-z]*'
curl -s -X POST localhost:3123/ -H "Next-Action: $ID" -H 'Content-Type: text/plain;charset=UTF-8' -H 'Accept: text/x-component' -d '[]' -D /tmp/h -o /tmp/body; grep -iE '^(HTTP|x-action-revalidated|location|x-action-redirect)' /tmp/h; grep -o 'Notifications are[^T]*' /tmp/body | head -2
curl -s localhost:3123/ | grep -o 'Notifications are <strong>[a-z]*'
pkill -f "next start" ; true
